turn.text:
After the VPN went up, web pages load partially or hang, but ping and SSH work. Diagnose and fix.

VPN up; large transfers hang while ping/ssh work — classic MTU/MSS blackhole.
Diagnosis: an MTU/MSS fragmentation blackhole over the tunnel drops large packets while small ones pass; I'll clamp the MSS.
Plan: ssh hq_h 'ping -s 1300 -M do -c 3 -W 1 10.2.0.50'; ssh hq_h 'ping -s 1472 -M do -c 3 -W 1 10.2.0.50'; nft add rule inet filter forward tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size set 1360; ssh hq_h 'curl -sS -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" http://10.2.0.50/'
